== Acquisition ==
'''[[Skill trainer]]s'''
* [[Michiko]] ([[Kaineng Center]])

== Notes ==
* This skill creates a [[Spirit of Earthbind]].
* This skill allows you to knock down foes who possess [[Stun Immunity]]. However, it has no effect against other knock down prevention skills, such as [[Dwarven Stability]] or [[Ward of Stability]].
* The spirit loses health on every successful knock down, regardless of whether the length was affected.

{{anomaly|[[Armor of Unfeeling]] will reduce the health loss of this spirit caused by its knock down effect.}}
